verdict.rationale: The New Jersey Division of Revenue and Enterprise Services is a state business-registry and filing agency. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user-built automations is not a fair question for this kind of product. Its filing amendments, record updates, and text/email notices are registry transactions and alerts, not user automations, so they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
